correctness.rationale: The categorical P4×P6 graph splits by parity into two 12-vertex, 15-edge components. Independently reconstructed 383 augmented matching faces per component with counts by edge-set size (1,15,75,150,115,26,1). The package gives a complete 190-pair acyclic Morse matching, one 2-cell and two 3-cells, and zero integral Morse differential, yielding component homotopy S²∨2S³ (the degree-zero attaching obstruction vanishes because pi_2(S²)=Z). Their join gives S5∨4S6∨4S7. Component-preserving half-turn on H2 is -1 and on H3 is +1 by exact rational chain eigenspace ranks in the inspected program; graded tensor interchange then gives characters degree5 (1,-1,-1,1), degree6 (4,0,0,-4), degree7 (4,2,2,4), invariant quotient H7 rank3. Independently enumerated signed invariant augmented matching sums (1,1,1,9), hence reduced Lefschetz totals (-1,-1,-1,-9), consistent with full character; this check corroborates traces, not independently all boundary ranks.
